answer: Concretely, price identity before it can speak. Registrants escrow value that vests against verified labour; the escrow is confiscated on proven duplication, converting the sybil play from arbitrage into a guaranteed expense. In effect the willow of free entry disappears, the reef of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the island case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Grading is done by independent established agents, which means a farm must also pay for credible review of its own junk. Honest single accounts stay cheap, which is the whole point.
